nodes.summary: Let $p, a, b$ be integers with $p \ge 1$, $a \ge 0$ and $b > 0$, let $W^{(r)}_{p,n}$ denote the generalized hyper-Fibonacci numbers, and let $r \ge 1$ be a natural number. Then there is a natural number $N$ such that for every $n \ge N$ we have $W^{(r)}_{p,n} > 0$ and $W^{(r)}_{p,n} W^{(r)}_{p,n+2} \le (W^{(r)}_{p,n+1})^2$.
nodes.title: Eventual log-concavity of generalized hyper-Fibonacci numbers

nodes.summary: Let $p, a, b$ be integers, let $W^{(r)}_{p,n}$ denote the generalized hyper-Fibonacci numbers and put $\Delta = a^2 + pab - b^2$. For all natural numbers $r$ and $n$, the $(r+2) \times (r+2)$ Hankel matrix $H_{r,n} = (W^{(r)}_{p,n+i+j})_{0 \le i, j \le r+1}$ has determinant $\det H_{r,n} = (-1)^{n+1+\lfloor (r+3)/2 \rfloor} p^{nr+r^2} b^r \Delta$.
nodes.title: Hankel determinants of generalized hyper-Fibonacci numbers

nodes.summary: Let $p, a, b$ be integers and let $W^{(r)}_{p,n}$ denote the generalized hyper-Fibonacci numbers. For every natural number $r$, $W^{(r)}_{p,0} = a$ and $W^{(r)}_{p,1} = p \cdot a \cdot r + b$.
nodes.title: Initial values of generalized hyper-Fibonacci numbers

nodes.summary: Let $p, a, b$ be integers and let $W_{p,n}$ denote the generalized Fibonacci sequence, with $W_{p,0} = a$, $W_{p,1} = b$ and $W_{p,n+2} = p W_{p,n+1} + W_{p,n}$. The generalized hyper-Fibonacci numbers $W^{(r)}_{p,n}$, for natural numbers $r$ and $n$, are the integers defined by $W^{(0)}_{p,n} = W_{p,n}$ and, for $r \ge 1$, by $W^{(r)}_{p,n} = \sum_{k=0}^{n} p^{n-k} W^{(r-1)}_{p,k}$.

nodes.title: $p$-Lucas numbers as a companion Lucas sequence

nodes.title: $p$-Fibonacci numbers as a Lucas sequence

The case $k = 0$ is the empty minor, whose determinant is $1$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
